factual_claims.claim: Tallinna Vesi reported improved financial performance in 2025, with growth in revenue, operating profit and profit before tax.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial results for 2025 section shows increases in sales (72.48M vs 65.08M), operating profit (21.22M vs 18.98M), and profit before taxes (17.43M vs 14.78M).

factual_claims.claim: Group sales increased by 11.4% to €72.48 million, supported by a 6.9% increase in water-services revenue to €62.31 million and a 62.0% rise in construction-services revenue to €8.46 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table shows sales growth of 11.4% to 72.48M. Sales breakdown table confirms water services revenue increased 6.9% to 62.31M and construction services revenue increased 62.0% to 8.46M.

factual_claims.claim: Revenue from private customers in the main service area grew 18.3% to €31.84 million, partly due to higher consumption and tariff changes, while business-customer revenue declined 2.7% to €16.76 million following reductions in business tariffs as prices were harmonised.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Sales table shows private customer revenue increased 18.3% to 31.84M. Business customer revenue decreased 2.7% to 16.76M. Management report explains this was due to tariff harmonization reducing business customer tariffs.

factual_claims.claim: Revenue from customers outside the main service area increased 13.8% to €7.71 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Sales table shows revenue from outside service area customers increased 13.8% to 7.71M.

factual_claims.claim: Gross profit rose 10.5% to €29.52 million, although the gross margin eased slightly to 40.73% from 41.04%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table shows gross profit increased 10.5% to 29.52M with gross margin decreasing from 41.04% to 40.73%.

factual_claims.claim: Operating profit increased 11.8% to €21.22 million and EBITDA rose to €30.95 million, lifting the EBITDA margin to 42.70%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table confirms operating profit increased 11.8% to 21.22M and EBITDA margin increased to 42.70%.

factual_claims.claim: Cost of goods and services sold increased 12.0% to €42.96 million, mainly because construction-services costs rose 74.5%, staff costs increased 6.8% and depreciation and amortisation rose 11.9%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cost of goods and services sold table shows 12.0% increase to 42.96M. Breakdown explains construction services costs +74.5%, staff costs +6.8%, and depreciation +11.9% were primary drivers.

factual_claims.claim: Direct production costs were broadly unchanged, as lower electricity purchases offset higher chemical and pollution-tax costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report states: 'Total direct production costs amounted to €9.90 million, remaining at the same level as the previous year. Direct production costs were mainly affected by: chemicals cost increase... electricity costs decrease... pollution charges increase.'

factual_claims.claim: The combined heat and power plant at the Paljassaare wastewater treatment plant reduced purchased electricity and was a key contributor to operating-profit growth.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report states: 'This increase [in operating profit] was mainly due to the optimisation of electricity costs following the launch of the combined heat and power plant.'

factual_claims.claim: Net financial expense declined to €3.78 million from €4.20 million, mainly because of lower Euribor rates.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial expenses section states: 'The group’s net financial income and expenses have resulted in a net expense of €3.78 million (2024: €4.20 million). This decrease was mainly due to the lower Euribor rate.'

factual_claims.claim: Profit before tax increased 18.0% to €17.43 million, while net profit rose 7.2% to €14.24 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table shows profit before tax increased 18.0% to 17.43M and net profit increased 7.2% to 14.24M.

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Profit before tax and net profit section states: 'Net profit was affected by an increase in the income tax rate on dividend payments.'

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Investments focused on pipe networks, stormwater systems, treatment facilities, smart meters and service continuity.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report and strategy section detail investments in pipe construction (45.1km in 2025), stormwater systems, treatment plant modernizations, smart meter rollout, and continuity measures.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow increased to €30.83 million, but investment cash outflows reached €45.15 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
